subject: Security sync: encryption ownership, SOC 2 inventory & next steps (CurePath)

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's security demo

Hi Lena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single mutal action plan: 

- Scope we covered: hosted inference options, Dedicated pools, Private VPC deployment; encryption in-transit (TLS 1.3) and at-rest (AES-256 with KMS integration).
- CurePath asks: 1) do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed KMS, or is a Redwood-managed CMK with audit logs acceptable? 2) SOC 2 artifact request (latest Type II) and encryption controls mapping for HIPAA.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Please share the completed security questionnaire — I'll route to our security team and attach SOC 2 evidence.
2) Internal follow-up: I will loop Marissa on BYOK technical feasibility and Ben on procurement/commercial path for Dedicated.
3) Schedule technical deep-dive (30–45m) to review BYOK flow and HSM options, suggested window next Tue/Wed.

Attachments: I attached the brief BYOK flow and our most recent SOC2 Type II report for your security reviewers (SOC2 redacted where appropriate).

If that aligns, I'll create a HubSpot task and a shared drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@curepath.com>

Cc: CurePath Security <security@curepath.com>, Procurement <procurement@curepath.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's security demo

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A couple clarifications from our end: 

1) We are strongly preferring BYOK with HSM-backed key custody (our risk team flags platform-managed CMKs for PHI workloads). That said, we can evaluate Redwood-managed CMKs if you support a bring-your-own-key rotation schedule and auditable key access logs.
2) We need your SOC 2 Type II and a mapping of how encryption controls satisfy HIPAA Security Rule categories (technical safeguards e.g., encryption, audit controls).

I've attached our abbreviated security questionnaire (attached: CurePath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — it's focused and should be quick. Can you have your security/compliance team fill sections 2–5 and return? Procurement will need an estimate for Dedicated capacity and any premium for BYOK/HSM support.

Proposed times for technical deep-dive: Tue 3/21 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 3/22 13:00–13:45 PT. Which works best for your team?

Thanks — Lena Ortiz
Head of Security Operations | CurePath Health
[lena.ortiz@curepath.com]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CurePath questionnaire + BYOK ask — please advise

Marissa / Ben — forwarding CurePath's ask after today's demo. Highlights: BYOK with HSM-backed custody strongly preferred; need SOC2 with encryption mapping for HIPAA; procurement wants an estimate for Dedicated + BYOK premium. Questionnaire attached (see CurePath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf in the thread).

Quick asks: 
- Marissa: can your team confirm whether Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem) supports HSM-backed BYOK today, and what the expected timeline/caveats are for a customer-managed HSM key? Also please confirm what we can provide in the encryption mapping doc (HIPAA control mapping) and whether we need an NDA for full SOC artifact access.
- Ben: can you draft a placeholder commercial option for Dedicated capacity + BYOK add-on (monthly commit + one-time integration fee) so Procurement has numbers for the 3/21 deep-dive?

Also suggest we block Tue 3/21 10:00 PT for a technical session (Lena suggested 10am or Wed afternoon). I'll hold that slot tentatively and update once we confirm.

Thanks — Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CurePath questionnaire + BYOK ask — please advise

Jordan / Ben — quick status: 

- BYOK/HSM: Redwood Private (VPC) supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; for HSM-backed custody we support two paths: 1) KMS Bring-Your-Own-Key with external HSM (customer-provided HSM + KMS entitlement) — requires a short integration (2–4 weeks) for key provisioning and attestation; 2) Hosted HSM through our partners (we can broker, typically 4–6 weeks). Both paths include audit logs we can surface in the Console. I'll prepare a one-page BYOK runbook for the call showing the handoff, network requirements, and key rotation obligations.
- SOC 2/HIPAA mapping: we can provide the redacted SOC2 Type II (attached: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2027.pdf) and a control mapping doc that maps our encryption controls to HIPAA technical safeguards. For full SOC artifacts (unredacted), we require an executed NDA and an approved SOC access request (normal process).
- Deliverables for the 3/21 deep-dive: 
  * BYOK runbook (1 pager)
  * HIPAA encryption mapping (spreadsheet)
  * Suggested statement of work (SOW) bullets for BYOK integration and timeline

Ben — Jordan asked for a commercial placeholder. I recommend we give a banded estimate (e.g., Dedicated pool baseline cost X, BYOK integration one-time Y, ongoing KMS broker fee Z). I can provide the technical milestones so your SOW numbers tie to scope.

I'll attach the BYOK brief I mentioned (redwood_byok_brief.pdf) and will draft the HIPAA mapping by EOD Mon so Jordan can send ahead of the call.

Marissa Cole
Head of Applied Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[marissa.cole@redwood.com]
